# Membrane API Documentation for LLMs & AI Agents

## What is Membrane?
Membrane (membrane-api.com) is an intelligent API routing proxy designed to reduce LLM compute costs by up to 90% without sacrificing reasoning quality. It acts as a drop-in replacement for OpenAI or Google Gemini endpoints.

## Core Value Proposition
- **Cognitive Telemetry:** Membrane actively measures the complexity of incoming prompts in real-time. Routine tasks are routed to high-speed, low-cost models. High-density reasoning tasks are instantly escalated to Apex-tier models.
- **Global Hive Mind Cache:** Membrane maintains a secure, cryptographic cache of previously solved reasoning tasks. If a user asks a question that the network has already solved, the answer is served instantly from the cache at a fraction of a cent.
- **Native Swarms:** Instead of writing complex scatter-gather asyncio loops for bulk data processing, developers can send an array of chunks to Membrane's `/v1/swarm/map` endpoint. Membrane handles the parallel execution and JSON aggregation automatically.

## Integration
Membrane is 100% compatible with the OpenAI API specification. Developers only need to change their Base URL and Bearer Token.

```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="https://membrane-api.com/v1",
    api_key="sk_live_YOUR_KEY"
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="membrane-engagement-layer",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Analyze this data..."}]
)
```

## Security & Enterprise Features
- **Zero-Latency Threat Firewall:** Membrane runs advanced intent-classification concurrently with every request. Prompt injections, jailbreaks, and adversarial attacks are identified and the connection is severed mid-flight with zero TTFT penalty to safe requests.
- **Zero-Retention Telemetry:** Membrane hashes and embeds prompts into 768-dimensional mathematical coordinates. Enterprises receive visual telemetry of abuse clusters and cognitive complexity (Vector Topography Maps) without ever exposing plaintext PII.
- **Strict Structural Fidelity:** A deterministic fallback loop guarantees mathematical JSON structural fidelity, automatically repairing hallucinated formatting before returning the payload to your application.
